sentence: This method is mostly chosen by researchers because of its comprehensiveness and transparency
passage: [Rojon et al. (2021), p. 196] "Scholars selected SRm for representing a rigorous, systematic, transparent and comprehensive approach to analysing, evaluating and synthesizing literature."

gemini.note: The passage confirms scholars select the method for its transparency and comprehensiveness, but does not state that it is 'mostly' chosen.
